title: TechOps Specialist (HL7 Integration)
description:
TechOps (HL7 Integration)


*English Resume Only

Role Type: Full-Time Contract

Hours: Must be willing to work US EST Hours

Location: Brazil

Reporting To: VP of Operations


About The Methodical Group


The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as ExactTalent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.


About the Opportunity


Our client, a growing healthcare SaaS organization, is seeking a Technical Operations Specialist to support post-sales technical implementations and system integrations.

This role is responsible for configuring and deploying HL7 interfaces within client environments, ensuring secure and accurate data connectivity between the SaaS platform and customer systems. The ideal candidate understands healthcare data workflows, integration standards, and how to work cross-functionally with client IT teams to enable seamless interoperability.

This is a post-sales, client-facing technical role that blends implementation, troubleshooting, and systems integration.


Ideal Candidate Profile


  • 3–6+ years of experience in healthcare IT, technical operations, or systems integration
  • Direct experience working with HL7 interfaces (v2.x preferred)
  • Experience connecting SaaS platforms to EHR or clinical systems
  • Strong understanding of healthcare data structures and workflows
  • Experience working with APIs, endpoints, or secure data transmission protocols
  • Ability to troubleshoot integration issues independently
  • Strong communication skills when working with client IT teams


Preferred Experience


  • Experience within a healthcare SaaS organization
  • Familiarity with EHR systems
  • Experience with interface engines
  • Knowledge of HIPAA-compliant data handling practices


Key Responsibilities


Post-Sales Implementation Support

  • Lead technical onboarding activities following customer contract execution
  • Configure and deploy HL7 interfaces within client instances
  • Coordinate with client IT and EHR teams to establish secure data connections
  • Ensure accurate mapping of inbound and outbound data fields

HL7 & Data Integration

  • Build, configure, and validate HL7 message interfaces
  • Support integration between the SaaS platform and client EHR or clinical systems
  • Troubleshoot data transmission errors and interface failures
  • Validate endpoint connectivity and message formatting

Client Collaboration

  • Serve as technical point of contact during implementation
  • Communicate integration requirements clearly to client technical stakeholders
  • Assist in diagnosing and resolving integration-related issues
  • Support go-live and stabilization efforts

System & Workflow Optimization

  • Monitor integration performance and data accuracy
  • Improve documentation around interface setup and troubleshooting
  • Contribute to process improvements within the technical operations function

title: Business Development Representative
description:
Sobre nós:

A UDS é especialista em desenvolver softwares web e aplicativos personalizados com squads ágeis. Atende marcas como Calvin Klein, DHL, C&A, Madero, SKY, Correios, Yamaha e outras. Foi reconhecida entre as três melhores desenvolvedoras de aplicativos da América Latina e detém certificação PCI-DSS. É a primeira de seu setor na Global Data Alliance junto a companhias como Panasonic, Visa, Pfizer e American Express.


Atividades:

• Prospecção ativa de leads outbound;

• Cadência de atividades com os leads, como ligações, wpp, emails;

• Reuniões de qualificação com os leads;

• Preenchimento de informações no CRM;

• Geração de demanda por canais como Linkedin.


Requisitos da vaga:

• Conhecimento nas plataformas de CRM como reev, Exact, pipedrive;

• Experiência em média de 3 anos com prospecção ativa;

• Tenha experiência com prospecção outbound (gere volume de reuniões diretamente);

• Tenha conhecimento do mercado de fintech / software para o mercado financeiro;

• Conhecimento em ferramentas de prospecção como sales navegator, snov.io, lusha, apollo;

• Conhecimento em social selling no Linkedin para gerar mais autoridade e prospectar.

title: Desenvolvedor Fullstack Sênior (Flutter e .Net)
description:
A Foursys é apaixonada por inovação, design e transformação digital.

Somos globais. Somos GPTW. E somos movidos por pessoas.

♿


Na Foursys, acreditamos que diversidade é potência. Valorizamos diferentes histórias, ideias e perspectivas — aqui, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras. São parte do que nos fortalece.

Quer fazer parte do time e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent ? Então olha essa oportunidade


Sobre a oportunidade:

Estamos buscando um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack Sênior com forte atuação em backend .NET e experiência sólida em Flutter para atuar em projetos estratégicos, com participação ativa nas decisões técnicas e arquitetura das soluções.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e manter APIs e serviços backend utilizando .NET (Core / .NET 6+)
  • Construir aplicações web e/ou mobile com Flutter
  • Projetar e implementar integrações entre frontend e backend
  • Garantir boas práticas de arquitetura, segurança e performance
  • Participar de decisões técnicas e definição de arquitetura
  • Realizar code review e contribuir com a qualidade do código
  • Colaborar com times de Produto, UX e QA
  • Apoiar troubleshooting e investigações técnicas em produção

title: Engenheiro de Exchange
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.



O que buscamos?

  • Especialista em Microsoft Exchange (On-Premises & Online) com foco em Segurança.


Principais responsabilidades técnicas:

  • Migração de Exchange On-Premises para Microsoft Exchange Online
  • Projetos e upgrades de Microsoft Exchange Server (2010, 2013, 2016, 2019)
  • Configuração híbrida, fluxo de e-mail (SMTP), DAG, alta disponibilidade e disaster recovery
  • Configuração de MX apontando para EOP ou gateways de terceiros
  • Scripting avançado em PowerShell
  • Health checks, troubleshooting avançado e recomendações de boas práticas


Infraestrutura & Identidade:

  • Arquitetura e administração de Active Directory (2008/2016)
  • Experiência sólida em ambientes on-premises
  • Cluster de Failover
  • Experiência comprovada em múltiplos projetos (mín. 5 anos em arquitetura, implantação e suporte)


Segurança e Compliance (diferencial importante):

  • Microsoft Defender for Office 365 (políticas de higiene de e-mail, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, Threat Explorer, Quarantine, Advanced Hunting)
  • Microsoft Purview (retenção, rótulos de sensibilidade, DLP, eDiscovery; diferenciais: Insider Risk, Information Barriers e Communication Compliance)



CLT FULL + Benefícios

Contrato híbrido para **eventuais** viagens e visitas a cliente.

· Contratação CLT;

· Vale Refeição;

· Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;

· Auxílio creche;

· Convênio com Farmácia;

· Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;

· Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;

· Seguro de Vida.



“O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).”

title: Software Engineer
description:
Position: Software Engineer (.NET/C#)

Contract Length: 12-month contract + extensions

Location: Remote (EST hours)

*This is a PJ contract opportunity working 40 hours a week*


Must Haves:

● 3-5+ years of coding experience in C#, ASP.NET and related languages

● Experience with Bitbucket/Github and Jira

● Working knowledge of database and storage such as Oracle, PostgreSQL, etc

● Optimizing SQL call performance.

● C1 or C2 level English


Plusses:

● Experience in React.

● Experience/knowledge within retail, ecommerce or Product Lifecycle Management systems (ideally Bamboo Rose)

Seeking an innovator in the design and development of C# software and applications for retail platforms, backend systems and databases. You will utilize your expertise and understanding of business requirements and functionality to build and improve functionality of various applications and systems supporting global retail commerce. We operate using the principles of Agile.


Compensation:

$15/hr to $25/hr USD.


Exact compensation may vary based on several factors, including skills, experience, and education.

title: Application Developer (Maintenance - JAVA/MySQL)
description:
We are looking for an Application Developer with strong experience in Java and My to support and enhance our client's application system, on the transportation product line.

The ideal candidate will be highly adept at working in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment with a small team, have proven on-time delivery experience, strong problem-solving abilities as well as aptitude to learn new technologies and concepts quickly, and be trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent.

Our industry-leading client provides cloud-based business automation software for over 2000 independent upstream and midstream oil & gas companies in North America. The companys solutions manage land, production, accounting, and transportation for E&P operators, crude oil purchasers, transporters, haulers, investors, and accounting firms. Their customers benefit through the automation of the most complex business processes to reduce operating costs, save time, and increase profitability via reporting, analytics, and decision support systems that were once exclusive to the major integrated oil companies.


Responsibilities

  • Portal & Server Management: Troubleshoot portal server ers, monitor AWS logs, and ensure report delivery.
  • ETL & Data Operations: Manage ETL file uploads, monitor ongoing/completed loads, and resolve missing data issues.
  • Reporting (JasperReports): Maintain and enhance custom reports, add/remove columns and filters, manage run tickets, and troubleshoot disappearing reports.
  • Database Management (My): Perform schema updates, optimize queries, and ensure data integrity for reporting and ETL processes.
  • Integrations: Support Samsara, Geotab, and Motive integrations and data imports.
  • Environment Management: Handle migrations between Alpha, Beta, and Production environments.
  • Bulk Updates: Execute mass-scale changes (Tank ID, Lease Name, Account, Terminal details) and perform data cleanup.


Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 3+ years of experience using Java and My
  • Solid understanding of AWS logs and backend troubleshooting, preferably using Cloud watch
  • Comfortable working in CI/CD environments with Agile development practices
  • Understanding of ETL & Data Management for file uploads and load monitoring
  • Detail-oriented and highly organized with a proactive mindset
  • Able to work independently and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Experience with JasperReports
  • Prior experience using React.js


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Clinical Statistical Programmer (SAS / CDISC) ||  Brazil
description:
Role :: Clinical Statistical Programmer (SAS / CDISC)

Location :: Brazil/Remote

Duration :: Long Term Contract


Role Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented Clinical Statistical Programmer to support clinical trial data standardization, analysis, and regulatory submissions. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in CDISC standards (SDTM & ADaM), SAS programming, and generation of Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLFs), along with experience in quality control and submission readiness.


Key Responsibilities

• Transform raw clinical trial data into CDISC-compliant SDTM and ADaM datasets

• Develop, validate, and maintain Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLFs) for clinical study reports and regulatory submissions

• Write efficient, well-documented SAS programs for data cleaning, derivations, and reporting

• Develop reusable Python or R scripts for automation, validation, and reproducible reporting

• Perform programming QC and peer reviews to ensure accuracy and traceability

• Prepare and maintain programming specifications, mapping documents, and annotated CRFs

• Troubleshoot complex data integration and derivation issues

• Support audits and regulatory inspections with reproducible code and documentation

Required Qualifications

• Strong experience with SAS programming

• Hands-on experience with CDISC standards (SDTM & ADaM)

• Experience generating TLFs for regulatory submissions

• Knowledge of clinical trial data structures and submission processes

• Familiarity with Python or R for automation (preferred)

• Strong attention to detail and documentation practices

Preferred

• Experience supporting FDA/EMA regulatory submissions

• Prior experience in a Pharma, Biotech, or CRO environment

title: ServiceNow Technical Architect
description:
ServiceNow Technical Architect


Start Date: ASAP

End Date: Aug 28, 2026

100% remote

English and Portuguese are required

Candidates from LATAM


We are seeking a true Technical Architect (not a developer/consultant) to lead and drive developers in a CSM workstream. This role is the technical leader responsible for designing, building, and maintaining ServiceNow’s unified customer engagement platform (NOW Engage), serving Expert Services and Partner consultants globally.


The Technical Architect translates business requirements into scalable, maintainable solutions, ensures platform integrity and performance, and provides hands‑on technical leadership across the full delivery lifecycle.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design scalable ServiceNow solutions aligned with best practices.
  • Lead architecture for multi‑tenant NOW Engage, ensuring security, data isolation, and performance.
  • Architect integrations with external systems (REST APIs, Integration Hub, AI/GenAI features).
  • Guide scrum teams, oversee code reviews, and enforce technical standards.
  • Collaborate with Business Analysts, executives, and cross‑functional teams to align business and technical goals.
  • Ensure compliance with enterprise standards, security, and regulatory requirements (GDPR, CCPA).
  • Drive continuous improvement through monitoring, automation, CI/CD, and documentation.


Requirements:

  • 6–10+ years of ServiceNow experience (development, administration, architecture).
  • Deep knowledge of ServiceNow products (CSM, SPM, ITSM, ITOM).
  • Expertise in custom app development, advanced data models, workflows, and API integrations.
  • Strong coding skills (JavaScript, REST/SOAP APIs, Integration Hub, UI Builder).
  • Experience with multi‑tenant architecture, scalability, and performance optimization.
  • Ability to clearly communicate technical concepts to non‑technical stakeholders.


Preferred

  • ServiceNow CTA, CIS, or CAD certifications.
  • Experience with AI/GenAI integrations and Agile/SAFe methodologies.
  • Leadership of scrum teams and collaboration with external vendors.
  • Knowledge of cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps.


Key Attributes

  • Architectural thinking and problem‑solving.
  • Strong technical leadership and quality focus.
  • Executive presence with excellent communication skills.
  • Collaborative and adaptable in dynamic environments.
  • Willingness to travel up to 25% annually.

title: Compliance Officer
description:
Compliance Officer


TG Lab is a technology company powering some of the biggest winners in sports betting and online casino products. We provide player account management and engagement technology to industry leaders such as Stake.com, Belgium National Lottery, Betsson Group , and many others. Our innovative yet practical solutions fuel world-class real-money wagering technology that supports over 1 million players. Our iGaming software is designed for distribution to casino and sportsbook operators across the EU, USA , and Asia.


We are looking for a meticulous and proactive Compliance Officer to ensure our operations and business activities adhere to all legal, technical and regulatory requirements, as well as internal policies. As a key member of the compliance team, you will work across departments to promote a strong compliance culture and help safeguard the company’s integrity and reputation.


Responsibilities:


  • Monitor and ensure compliance with relevant regulatory authorities (MGA, Mincetur, SPA, AGCO etc.) 
  • Ensure compliance with relevant frameworks (e.g., GDPR, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS).
  • Conduct regular audits and technical assessments to evaluate risk and compliance.
  • Develop and maintain compliance documentation, including security policies, data handling procedures, and audit reports.
  • Assist Chief Compliance officer to launch the new project in existing or new markets.
  • Stay up to date with changes in laws and regulations affecting data privacy,  various regulatory frameworks, cybersecurity, and industry standards.
  • Provide guidance and training to staff on compliance-related matters.
  • Manage third-party vendor compliance assessments and onboarding processes.
  • Coordinate internal and external audits; respond to audit findings and implement corrective actions.
  • Assist in incident response investigations and ensure post-incident compliance actions are executed.


Requirements:


  • 2-4 years of experience in compliance or risk/aml management (IT security would be a plus).
  • Previous experience in compliance, data protection laws and cyber security.
  • Exceptional documentation and analytical skills.


Working with us implies:

﻿

  • Memorable company parties and social activities like team buildings and monthly birthday celebrations.
  • Working in a company with a global culture, experience, and reach.
  • Working on-site in our modern, bright, and comfortable office space located in downtown Foz do Iguaçu, with a great working atmosphere, a collaborative team of amazing people, and open-minded managers.
  • Opportunities to build valuable skills, work with unique and interesting projects for the sports industry, express and implement your ideas and grow your career.


The monthly salary range will depend on the selected candidate's experience and skills. We will contact only shortlisted candidates.

  • Ensure compliance with relevant frameworks (e.g., GDPR, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS).
  • Conduct regular audits and technical assessments to evaluate risk and compliance.
  • Develop and maintain compliance documentation, including security policies, data handling procedures, and audit reports.
  • Assist Chief Compliance officer to launch the new project in existing or new markets.
  • Stay up to date with changes in laws and regulations affecting data privacy,  various regulatory frameworks, cybersecurity, and industry standards.
  • Provide guidance and training to staff on compliance-related matters.
  • Manage third-party vendor compliance assessments and onboarding processes.
  • Coordinate internal and external audits; respond to audit findings and implement corrective actions.
  • Assist in incident response investigations and ensure post-incident compliance actions are executed.


Requirements:


  • 2-4 years of experience in compliance or risk/aml management (IT security would be a plus).
  • Previous experience in compliance, data protection laws and cyber security.
  • Exceptional documentation and analytical skills.


Working with us implies:

﻿

  • Memorable company parties and social activities like team buildings and monthly birthday celebrations.
  • Working in a company with a global culture, experience, and reach.
  • Working on-site in our modern, bright, and comfortable office space located in downtown Foz do Iguaçu, with a great working atmosphere, a collaborative team of amazing people, and open-minded managers.
  • Opportunities to build valuable skills, work with unique and interesting projects for the sports industry, express and implement your ideas and grow your career.


The monthly salary range will depend on the selected candidate's experience and skills. We will contact only shortlisted candidates.

title: Project Manager
description:
Join Aditi Consulting as a Project Manager!


Summary:

We are seeking a Project Manager to support a global M&A divestiture initiative involving the disposition of 150+ applications across multiple regions, including significant collaboration with teams in Japan . This role requires ERP experience (SAP, Epicor, ETQ, Reliance, or similar), strong technical communication skills, and the ability to manage tight timelines driven by Transition Service Agreements (TSAs) .

Responsibilities:

  • Lead global application disposition efforts across multiple waves of work.
  • Manage timelines tied to TSA deadlines to avoid costly extensions.
  • Coordinate closely with technical teams on integrations, workflows, and decommissioning plans.
  • Work with sourcing, suppliers, purchasing, and invoicing teams to ensure vendor alignment.
  • Facilitate meetings with global stakeholders, including late-night sessions with Japan-based teams (flex schedule provided).
  • Drive project planning, risk management, documentation, and status reporting.
  • Ensure smooth communication and alignment across business, IT, and regional teams.

Required Qualifications:

  • Proven Project Management experience in M&A divestiture environments.
  • Familiarity with Transition Service Agreements (TSAs) .
  • Experience with at least one ERP or enterprise platform (SAP, Epicor, ETQ, Reliance, etc.).
  • Strong understanding of sourcing, suppliers, purchasing, and invoicing processes.
  • Excellent English communication skills , including the ability to follow technical integration discussions.
  • Experience working with global or cross-cultural teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Project Management certification (PMP, Prince2, Agile/Scrum).
  • Experience collaborating with Japan or APAC teams.
  • Background in application disposition, decommissioning, or IT transformation.
  • Knowledge of integration workflows and system dependencies.

Soft Skills:

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication abilities.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity and drive clarity in complex technical environments.
  • Proactive risk identification and problem-solving.
  • High level of organization and multitasking in fast-paced settings.
  • Flexibility and adaptability when working across global time zones.

title: Visual Designer – Pleno
description:
Código da vaga: 58109


Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei #fera em design visual, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos por #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • Forte domínio de design de informação e hierarquia visual .
  • Storytelling aplicado : começo–meio–fim, argumento, ritmo, síntese e foco no essencial.
  • Capacidade de entender o contexto antes de desenhar : fazer perguntas, captar objetivos e propor caminhos.
  • Excelência em padronização e construção de sistemas : templates e componentes reutilizáveis.
  • Experiência com Microsoft Power Point, Power Designer .
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado para lidar com materiais.


- O que vai te destacar?

  • Materiais para consultorias (estratégia/produto/branding/design).
  • Storytelling para executivos e apresentações de alto impacto.
  • Design systems aplicados a apresentações e documentos.
  • Criação de bibliotecas de templates do zero .



- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei #fera em design visual, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos por #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • Forte domínio de design de informação e hierarquia visual .
  • Storytelling aplicado : começo–meio–fim, argumento, ritmo, síntese e foco no essencial.
  • Capacidade de entender o contexto antes de desenhar : fazer perguntas, captar objetivos e propor caminhos.
  • Excelência em padronização e construção de sistemas : templates e componentes reutilizáveis.
  • Experiência com Microsoft Power Point, Power Designer .
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado para lidar com materiais.


- O que vai te destacar?

  • Materiais para consultorias (estratégia/produto/branding/design).
  • Storytelling para executivos e apresentações de alto impacto.
  • Design systems aplicados a apresentações e documentos.
  • Criação de bibliotecas de templates do zero .



- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Instructional Designer
description:
Instructional Designer/Training Content Creator


*English Resume Only

Role Type: Full-Time Contract

Hours: Must be willing to work US EST Hours

Location: Brazil

Reporting To: VP of Operations


About The Methodical Group


The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as ExactTalent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.


About the Opportunity


Our client, a growing SaaS organization within the healthcare sector, is seeking an experienced Instructional Designer / Content Training Creator to support product adoption and end-user engagement.

This individual will be responsible for developing high-quality training materials aligned to new feature releases and product enhancements. Content will include step-by-step documentation, video tutorials, and embedded in-app learning resources.

The ideal candidate is structured, detail-oriented, and highly collaborative — capable of working cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, and Support teams to ensure training materials are accurate, timely, and aligned with customer needs.

title: Senior Front-End Software Engineer (React.js / React Native / TypeScript)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Front-End Software Engineer with 5+ years of professional front-end development experience using React.js, React Native, and TypeScript for our U.K. / U.S. client. You will design, build, and maintain high‑impact user interfaces — from customer dashboards and data visualizations to our React Native mobile app.

Our client is a nature data and intelligence company on a mission to drive large-scale nature recovery. They combine data, science, and technology to help enterprises value and restore nature, creating measurable environmental and economic impact.


Responsibilities

  • Own front-end delivery for key product surfaces across web and mobile taking features from technical feasibility through technical design, implementation, release, and iteration
  • Build and evolve UI foundations including component patterns, design-system primitives, reusable layouts, and interaction standards that keep UX consistent as the product scales
  • Translate product and design intent into clear, intuitive user flows sweating the details on information hierarchy, micro-interactions, accessibility, and polish
  • Ship performant, data-heavy interfaces in Next.js / React.js, with strong attention to perceived performance (e.g., loading states, empty states, progressive disclosure, and responsiveness)
  • Contribute meaningfully to the React Native app, delivering cross-platform UI and shared patterns where it makes sense, while handling platform-specific edge cases when needed
  • Use automated testing to ensure the UI quality, stability, and performance
  • Partner tightly with Product, Design, and Tech Lead to scope work into thin, shippable increments, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and keep delivery moving without sacrificing quality


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of professional experience building production, front-end applications with React.js and TypeScript
  • Experience building and supporting cross-platform, React Native features in a production application
  • Strong eye for UI and UX quality, paying close attention to interaction behavior, information hierarchy, accessibility, and polish
  • Proven experience implementing and operating within a component library / design system (e.g., tokens, reusable components, consistency, and documentation) in close collaboration with Design
  • Strong fundamentals in state management, responsive design, and performance optimization including perceived performance (e.g., loading states, skeletons, optimistic UI, and smooth interactions)
  • Comfortable taking ambiguous product requirements and turning them into clear UI flows, iterating quickly with stakeholders, and owning outcomes
  • Shareable portfolio or examples of UI work (e.g. links, screenshots) as well as the ability to explain what you personally owned and enhanced
  • Proactive mindset and the ability to self-manage in a distributed environment
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack Pleno (Python/RAG)
description:
• VAGA PJ
  • MODELO REMOTO


Requisitos da vaga:

• Desenvolver, manter e evoluir aplicações web full-stack, atuando tanto no back-end quanto no front-end.

• Criar e integrar APIs HTTP/REST, garantindo eficiência, organização e boas práticas de arquitetura.

• Projetar, consultar e manipular bancos de dados SQL, incluindo criação de tabelas, inserções, atualizações e otimizações.

• Implementar soluções em ambiente AWS, utilizando serviços como Lambda, API Gateway, S3 e SQS em arquiteturas Serverless.

• Participar ativamente na definição, construção e manutenção da arquitetura de software, contribuindo com boas práticas de modelagem e escalabilidade.

• Desenvolver interfaces web responsivas e modernas utilizando React, Next.js, HTML/CSS e recursos de PWA.

• Integrar aplicações front-end com APIs REST, preferencialmente usando Axios ou similares.

• Utilizar TypeScript e Prisma no desenvolvimento de aplicações back-end e front-end, garantindo tipagem, segurança e qualidade do código.

• Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares na definição de requisitos, soluções técnicas e fluxos de desenvolvimento.

• Garantir versionamento, organização do código e fluxo de desenvolvimento utilizando Git.

• Participar de revisões de código, propor melhorias técnicas e contribuir para a evolução contínua dos padrões de desenvolvimento.

• Monitorar, corrigir bugs e implementar melhorias contínuas tanto no front-end quanto no back-end.


Requisitos da vaga:

• Conhecimentos em programação, principalmente em Python

• Conhecimento de React e Next.js

• Conhecimento de SQL para consultas e inserções ou alterações no banco de dados e criação de tabelas

• Conhecimento de AWS: Funções λ, API Gateway, S3, SQS

• Conhecimento de criação de APIs HTTP/REST

• Conhecimento do arcabouço Serverless

• Conhecimento de IA, e utilização de RAGs

• Git


Desejável:

• Experiência com modelagem de banco de dados e soluções em arquitetura de software

• Conhecimento em TypeScript

• Conhecimento de Prisma

• Conhecimento em Progressive Web Apps (PWA) e responsividade

• Conhecimento HTML/CSS;

• Conhecimento de consumo de APIs HTTP/REST, preferencialmente usando Axios.

• Conhecimento de Redux

title: Coordenador de Operações AMS SAP
description:
O que procuramos?

Atribuições principais:

Apoiar no estabelecimento e garantir o cumprimento dos objetivos do projeto;

Criar cronogramas, liderar reuniões, acompanhar escopos, prazos e prioridades determinantes;

Apoiar o Gerente de Operações na garantia do quadro de profissionais exigidos no projeto, analisando o perfil desejado e participando do processo de seleção com o setor responsável;

Apoiar as áreas de negócio no entendimento dos tratamentos e fluxos de dados da empresa;

Acompanhar reuniões de alinhamento e diretrizes com o cliente;

Organizar dados e gerar relatórios, subsidiando tomadas de decisões;

Realizar negociações de prazos e entregas;

Apoiar o Gerente de Operações em projetos de escopo aberto;

Coordenar a equipe do projeto/alocação, garantindo o padrão de governança da Meta;

Divulgar estratégias e informações para a equipe de apoio.


Requisitos:

  • Gestão de múltiplas demandas: Capacidade de lidar com diferentes frentes de trabalho e tarefas simultâneas, organizando fluxos e prioridades para garantir entregas dentro do prazo e com a qualidade esperada.
  • Gestão de equipes: Experiência em liderar, motivar e desenvolver equipes, assegurando alinhamento com metas, prazos e objetivos estratégicos.
  • Implementação, suporte e customização de sistemas: Atuação em projetos de implementação, sustentação e melhorias contínuas, garantindo aderência às necessidades do negócio.
  • Conhecimento em ERP SAP: Vivência com sistemas SAP, incluindo módulos como SAP S/4HANA, SAP FICO, SAP MM e SAP SD, aplicados aos processos de negócio.
  • Gestão de contratos e SLAs: Experiência na gestão de contratos de prestação de serviços, controle de SLAs e acompanhamento de KPIs, assegurando a qualidade e a continuidade dos serviços.
  • Conhecimentos em pacote Office: Domínio do pacote Office, com ênfase em Excel para análises, controles e elaboração de relatórios gerenciais.
  • Conhecimento em TI: Compreensão dos processos, tecnologias e fluxos envolvidos em ambientes e operações de TI.
  • Habilidade em negociações: Capacidade de negociar com equipes, clientes e stakeholders, buscando soluções equilibradas e orientadas a resultados.
  • Resolução de problemas: Capacidade de identificar, analisar e solucionar problemas operacionais, técnicos ou de relacionamento, minimizando impactos para clientes e equipes.
  • Comunicação clara e assertiva: Habilidade de comunicação eficaz, tanto verbal quanto escrita, garantindo alinhamento entre equipes, clientes e demais stakeholders.
  • Atuação proativa: Postura orientada a resultados, com senso de responsabilidade e iniciativa para antecipar demandas e propor melhorias.
  • Flexibilidade e adaptabilidade: Capacidade de atuar em ambientes dinâmicos, lidando com mudanças e ajustando processos conforme as necessidades da operação e do cliente.
  • Idioma: Inglês Avançado/Boa conversação.


Localidade da posição:

Remoto.


Por que construir sua carreira na Meta?

Oferecemos autonomia, metas claras e um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, onde os profissionais têm oportunidade de interagir com diferentes tecnologias, participar de todos os tipos de projetos, trazer novas ideias e trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil e (por que não?) do mundo. Além disso, somos uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil segundo o Great Place to Work e uma das 10 empresas que mais crescem no país há 3 anos consecutivos, segundo o Anuário Informática Hoje.


Quais são nossos valores?

- Somos pessoas servindo pessoas

- Pensamos e agimos como donos

- Temos gana por performance

- Crescemos e aprendemos juntos

- Buscamos excelência e a simplicidade

- Temos inovação e criatividade no nosso DNA

Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas independentemente de sua condição, deficiência, etnia, crença religiosa, orientação sexual, aparência, idade ou afins. Queremos que você cresça conosco em um ambiente acolhedor e repleto de oportunidades.

Se identificou? Então, #VemSerMeta!

title: DevOps Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Summary:

We are seeking a highly skilled Backend Infrastructure Engineer to support critical Kinetix infrastructure modernization initiatives. This role will lead server migrations, environment configurations, cloud platform updates, and backend system readiness across multiple Kinetix components. The engineer will play a key role in ensuring operational continuity as we transition away from end‑of‑life systems and move toward secure, compliant cloud environments.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead and execute end‑to‑end server migration projects.
  • Configure, maintain, and optimize Windows and Linux server environments.
  • Support cloud platform updates, primarily in Microsoft Azure.
  • Troubleshoot backend configuration, connectivity, and performance issues.
  • Manage and update networking components including DNS, certificates, load balancing, VPNs, and firewalls.
  • Document infrastructure configurations, processes, and changes.
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to ensure system stability and readiness.
  • Support infrastructure modernization and cloud compliance initiatives.

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in backend infrastructure, DevOps, or systems engineering.
  • Hands‑on experience with server migrations and infrastructure modernization.
  • Strong knowledge of both Windows and Linux server administration.
  • Proficiency in networking technologies (DNS, certificates, load balancers, VPNs, firewalls).
  • Experience working with Azure ; AWS experience is a plus.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills for configuration and connectivity issues.
  • Excellent documentation and communication abilities.
  • Advanced English proficiency.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in the railroad industry is preferred.
  • AWS exposure or certifications.
  • Automation or scripting skills (PowerShell, Bash, Python, etc.).
  • Monitoring tools experience (e.g., Azure Monitor, Grafana, Splunk).
  • CI/CD familiarity.

Soft Skills:

  • Strong communication and documentation capabilities.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
  • Proactive problem‑solver with a collaborative mindset.
  • Adaptability to fast‑paced environments.

title: Desenvolvedor Java com AWS
description:
Desenvolvedor Java com AWS


Local: atuação remota

Tipo de Contrato: CLT

Nível: Pleno


Sobre a Vaga:

Como Desenvolvedor Java com AWS, você será responsável por projetar, desenvolver e implementar aplicações escaláveis e eficientes na nuvem. Você trabalhará em colaboração com equipes multifuncionais para entregar soluções que atendam às necessidades dos nossos clientes e do negócio.


Responsabilidades:

- Desenvolver, testar e manter aplicações em Java, garantindo alta qualidade e desempenho.

- Projetar e implementar soluções utilizando Amazon Web Services (AWS), como EC2, S3, RDS e Lambda.

- Colaborar com equipes de design e produto para definir requisitos e especificações das aplicações.

- Participar de revisões de código e garantir melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.

- Implementar e manter processos de integração contínua e entrega contínua (CI/CD).

- Diagnosticar e resolver problemas de desempenho e segurança nas aplicações.


Requisitos:

- Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de aplicações usando Java.

- Conhecimento prático em AWS e serviços relacionados.

- Familiaridade com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (ex.: MySQL, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB).

- Experiência em frameworks Java, como Spring ou Hibernate.

- Compreensão de práticas de desenvolvimento ágil e metodologias DevOps.

- Habilidade em trabalhar em equipe e colaborar de forma eficaz.

- Conhecimento de ambientes de governança do seguimento financeiro.


Diferenciais:

- Certificações em AWS ou outras tecnologias relevantes.

- Experiência com contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes).

- Conhecimento em desenvolvimento frontend (ex.: React, Angular) é um diferencial.

Responsabilidades:

- Desenvolver, testar e manter aplicações em Java, garantindo alta qualidade e desempenho.

- Projetar e implementar soluções utilizando Amazon Web Services (AWS), como EC2, S3, RDS e Lambda.

- Colaborar com equipes de design e produto para definir requisitos e especificações das aplicações.

- Participar de revisões de código e garantir melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.

- Implementar e manter processos de integração contínua e entrega contínua (CI/CD).

- Diagnosticar e resolver problemas de desempenho e segurança nas aplicações.


Requisitos:

- Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de aplicações usando Java.

- Conhecimento prático em AWS e serviços relacionados.

- Familiaridade com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (ex.: MySQL, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB).

- Experiência em frameworks Java, como Spring ou Hibernate.

- Compreensão de práticas de desenvolvimento ágil e metodologias DevOps.

- Habilidade em trabalhar em equipe e colaborar de forma eficaz.

- Conhecimento de ambientes de governança do seguimento financeiro.


Diferenciais:

- Certificações em AWS ou outras tecnologias relevantes.

- Experiência com contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes).

- Conhecimento em desenvolvimento frontend (ex.: React, Angular) é um diferencial.

title: Node.JS Developer
description:
Node.JS Developer

Brazil/Argentina (Remote)

Contract

Responsibility

  • Develop and maintain server-side Node.js applications using the Express.js framework, OpenAPI, API Gateway, and Swagger specifications.
  • Work with a team of developers to design, implement, and test new features.
  • Optimize and troubleshoot existing applications to improve performance and reliability.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.
  • Collaborate with front-end developers to integrate server-side and client-side applications.
  • Mentor and coach junior developers on the team
  • Keep up to date with the latest Node.js, Express.js, OpenAPI, API Gateway, Swagger, and Jest developments.


Qualifications

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills


Bonus Points

  • Experience with cloud computing platforms such as AWS or Azure
  • Experience with container orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes
  • Experience with continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines
  • Experience with leading and mentoring development teams

title: Tech Lead
description:
Na Printi, acreditamos que cada detalhe faz a diferença, mas o que realmente importa é você, independente de sua origem, identidade ou crenças!


Somos uma empresa composta por um time diverso e inclusivo de pessoas #Printers, sempre prontas para transformar ideias em realidade gráfica. Valorizamos a pluralidade e buscamos proporcionar soluções para negócios de todos os tamanhos e segmentos, atendendo de pequenos empreendedores a grandes corporações.


Desde 2012, atuamos no mercado brasileiro com o investimento e a expertise do grupo Cimpress, líder global em customização em massa. Com um portfólio extenso, tecnologia de ponta, preços competitivos e prazos rápidos, oferecemos mais do que produtos: oferecemos confiança, respeito e parcerias duradouras.


Venha fazer parte dessa história de sucesso e inovação, com um ambiente de trabalho e soluções que celebram a diversidade e promovem a igualdade. A Printi é grande e, com você, seremos ainda maiores!


Responsabilidades :


  • Atuar como referência técnica da squad, orientando o time na definição de soluções, revisão de código e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Garantir o andamento das entregas técnicas, organizando prioridades com o time e acompanhando o progresso junto ao PM, antecipando riscos e removendo impedimentos.
  • Colaborar com PMs, Designers e QAs desde a concepção, ajudando a transformar objetivos de produto em decisões técnicas viáveis, claras e sustentáveis.
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento técnico do time, apoiando na mentoria de pessoas desenvolvedoras e fortalecendo a autonomia e consistência da squad.
  • Garantir visibilidade e organização do trabalho técnico, mantendo a documentação essencial e promovendo o compartilhamento de conhecimento.
  • Propor e acompanhar melhorias contínuas de arquitetura, ferramentas e processos que aumentem a qualidade, estabilidade e eficiência do time.


Requisitos :


  • Formação superior em Ciências da Computação, Sistema de Informação, Engenharia de Software, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos como Tech Lead.
  • Vivência em times orientados a produto


Benefícios :


  • Plano médico e odontológico Amil para cuidar de você e sua família;
  • Vale alimentação/refeição, disponibilizado num cartão flexível;
  • Auxilio Home Office;
  • Day off no dia do seu aniversário, para celebrar seu dia especial como merece;
  • Participação nos lucros e resultados;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Total pass, para garantir um estilo de vida saudável e equilibrado, para você e seus dependentes;
  • Vittude: 40% de desconto em sessões de psicoterapia online;
  • Desconto de 20% nos produtos da Printi para você aproveitar.

title: Software Engineer
description:
About the Role: Our client is looking for a Software Engineer who balances deep coding expertise with a strong architectural mindset. You will not only develop features but also design the infrastructure that powers AI-driven content ecosystems for a telecommunications firms in the US. This role requires a unique blend of AI implementation (RAG/LLM), DevOps automation, and Enterprise Security (SSO).


Responsibilities:


  • Engineering & Development: Build and maintain scalable applications using Python or Node.js, ensuring high performance and clean, maintainable code.


  • AI Orchestration: Implement and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines and integrate Large Language Models into production environments.


  • Infrastructure & DevOps: Architect CI/CD pipelines specifically designed for automated content creation and management workflows.


  • Identity & Security: Lead the implementation of Single Sign-On (SSO) solutions (SAML, OIDC) to ensure secure access across internal platforms.


  • Technical Documentation: Produce high-quality technical content and documentation. You must be able to explain complex engineering decisions clearly to US-based stakeholders.


Requirements:

  • Core Engineering: Experience in Software Engineering with a strong foundation in data structures and system design.


  • AI/LLM Proficiency: Practical experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks for building RAG-based systems.


  • Security & Identity: Solid understanding of authentication and authorization protocols (SSO/IAM).


  • DevOps Focus: Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and automating content lifecycles.


  • Writing Excellence: Strong command of written English for technical whitepapers and documentation


Location: (Remote)


Please, send you CV in English

title: Brazilian International Recruiter – Belém (Hybrid)
description:
We are looking for ambitious and career-driven candidates for an exciting opportunity in our international recruitment agency!

This is a full-time opportunity offering the chance to learn everything about international recruitment while working in a hybrid setup based in Belém.


About Us

We are a leading international recruitment specialist agency working with businesses all over the world, connecting multilingual talent with exciting job opportunities across multiple markets.

We are a language-focused recruitment agency in Europe, matching top opportunities with international talent. We have multiple offices across Europe and remote colleagues worldwide. To date, we have helped thousands of people find their dream job with hundreds of partners across more than 40 countries.


Your Role as a Brazilian International Recruiter

As an International Recruiter, you will:

  • Create eye-catching and informative job advertisements
  • Proactively headhunt candidates using job boards, databases, and sourcing tools
  • Use social media platforms to attract and engage candidates
  • Screen applications and conduct interviews via video
  • Prepare candidate presentations and follow up with clients throughout recruitment processes
  • Build strong relationships with both candidates and clients
  • Manage your time effectively and work toward weekly and monthly KPIs
  • Work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment


Market Focus

In this role, you will:

  • Recruit mainly for the Brazilian and Portuguese-speaking markets (locally for Brazil/or abroad)
  • Support international recruitment projects for European clients
  • Potentially work on additional markets (such as Spanish-speaking markets) depending on business needs


To Be Successful in This Role, You Are…

  • Fluent-level Brazilian Portuguese speaker
  • Fluent in English
  • Comfortable working with computer tools, CRM systems, sourcing platforms, and databases
  • Interested in an international career and working with people
  • Structured and able to multitask
  • A positive, solution-oriented problem solver
  • A strong communicator who enjoys speaking with candidates and clients
  • Goal-oriented and motivated by achieving targets (sales experience is a plus)
  • Adaptable and able to work with deadlines
  • Self-driven but also a strong team player


Why Join Us?

  • Structured and interactive onboarding process with training and support
  • Continuous learning opportunities and career development
  • High levels of responsibility and ownership
  • Opportunity to work in a fast-growing international company
  • Long-term career opportunities locally and globally
  • International environment with regular team activities and social events
  • Competitive base salary + commission structure


Work Setup

  • Hybrid work
  • Location: Belém


We are looking for someone who fits into a high-performance, fast-paced culture, with a vibrant work environment where communication and proactivity are key to helping people find life-changing opportunities.


If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you.


Apply now and let’s talk!

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Job Title: SENIOR DEVOPS ENGINEER (REMOTE)


About:

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


Job Summary :


Position Description

This is a remote working opportunity and you can work anywhere as long as you have a strong internet connection and the discipline to work alone. You will be working closely with other DevOPS engineers, software engineers and contributors on the project.


Responsibilities

  • Building and setting up new development tools and infrastructure
  • Understanding the needs of stakeholders and conveying this to developers
  • Working on ways to automate and improve development and release processes
  • Ensuring that systems are safe and secure against cybersecurity threats
  • Identifying technical problems and developing software updates and ‘fixes’
  • Working with software developers and software engineers to ensure that development follows established processes and works as intended


Minimum Qualifications

  • Advanced level of written and oral English proficiency
  • 5+ years experience as DevOPS/SRE at AWS environment
  • Exceptional leadership, time management, facilitation, and organizational skills


Must-Have Technologies

  • ELK Stack
  • Ansible
  • Grafana
  • Terraform
  • Kubernetes
  • Docker
  • Fastly


Benefits

- Yearly Office Allowance Budget

- Macbook Purchase Support

- Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.


Flatiron has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack
description:
Sobre nós

Somos uma Venture Builder que ajuda startups a desenvolverem produtos de tecnologia para o mercado. Já desenvolvemos centenas de projetos e lançamos mais de 15 startups.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Participar da definição de arquitetura e soluções técnicas para produtos em fase inicial
  • Desenvolver aplicações web fullstack, do protótipo ao deploy
  • Construir PoCs para avaliar tecnologias e validar hipóteses de negócio


Requisitos

  • 3+ anos de experiência desenvolvendo aplicações web
  • Conhecimento sólido em React
  • Conhecimento sólido em Python


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com FastAPI e/ou Django
  • Vivência com AWS, Azure ou GCP


O que você vai encontrar

  • Exposição a múltiplos produtos e domínios de negócio — a variedade que só uma Venture Builder oferece
  • Time enxuto onde sua opinião pesa nas decisões técnicas
  • Feedbacks periódicos e realistas sobre desempenho e evolução
  • Home office com horário flexível
  • Valorizamos comunicação clara, transparência e honestidade nas relações com clientes, colaboradores e fornecedores - e esperamos o mesmo de quem entra no time.

title: Parceiro de Negócios |  B2B | Tecnologia Tributária | Partner Sênior
description:
Parceria Estratégica: Oportunidade para Profissionais com Visão Empreendedora


Buscamos profissionais de mercado com perfil comercial e experiência consultiva para expandir nosso núcleo de parceiros.


Se você busca autonomia e resultados, o Grupo AG Taxtech oferece uma parceria estratégica para atuar com soluções tributárias que geram impacto direto no fluxo de caixa das empresas e compliance tributário, folha de pagamento e eSocial.


O que oferecemos:

•Flexibilidade : Atuação 100% remota, sem conflito com outras atividades. Contrato Parceiro PJ | Início Imediato.


•Suporte Completo : Equipe técnica especializada, ferramentas tecnológicas e acompanhamento em todas as etapas do negócio.


•Tecnologia de Ponta : Nossa metodologia, pioneira como a primeira TaxTech do Brasil (15 anos de mercado), audita mais de 80 rubricas, revelando oportunidades que abordagens convencionais não alcançam.


•Segurança e Compliance : Comprovamos 15 anos sem revés, seguro contra erros e omissões, e garantia de CND em contrato.


•Remuneração: Modelo 100% comissionado, alinhado ao seu desempenho e ao valor gerado.

Ciclo de venda curto e repasse de comissão rápido.


Sua atuação:

•Identificação e captação de novas oportunidades de negócios.

•Desenvolvimento de parcerias estratégicas e gestão de carteira de clientes (Lucro Presumido e Real).

•Apresentação de soluções que otimizam a carga tributária e promovem compliance.


| Tributário | Previdenciário | Revisão Custos Folha de Pagamento | B2B | Revisão Fiscal | Compliance eSocial


Se você busca uma parceria que valoriza sua expertise e oferece uma estrutura robusta para alavancar seus resultados, convidamos você a conhecer o Grupo AG Capital.

title: Systems Architect – Prediction Market
description:
About the Role

Forkast is a prediction market where crypto traders and gamers predict real-world events. Real-time, high-integrity infrastructure where every millisecond counts. We’re looking for a hands-on Systems Architect to take our trading engine from exceptional to elite.


The ideal candidate has scaled production-grade systems at serious volume. This isn’t a whiteboard-only position. This is a high-stakes engineering role at the intersection of finance, crypto, and frontier prediction market systems design.


You’ll be solving performance bottlenecks, owning major redesigns, and championing best practices in distributed computing.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead the evolution of our trading engine, scaling throughput, reliability, and latency.
  • Design and optimize the integration between off-chain matching engines and on-chain settlement (USDC on Arbitrum).
  • Apply industry-standard approaches to distributed systems design, ensuring consistency, fault tolerance, and correctness.
  • Establish and implement robust observability practices, including tracing, metrics, logging, and alerting.
  • Design and scale data storage systems, including database partitioning, sharding, and performance tuning.
  • Guide the team in implementing complex designs correctly through code reviews, technical direction, and hands-on collaboration.
  • Step in as a builder when needed: implement performance-critical components, optimize in-memory order books, and improve messaging and data pipelines.


What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience scaling high-throughput, low-latency trading systems or similar distributed platforms in production.
  • Deep understanding of trading engine architecture, including settlement, batching, state consistency, and failure modes.
  • Hands-on experience with system-level performance optimization and distributed systems.
  • Practical experience setting up and operating monitoring, tracing, and observability tools at scale.
  • Experience designing and scaling databases, including partitioning strategies and data access optimization.
  • Coding alongside the team. Hands-on contributions, not just oversight.
  • Ability to guide a team in adopting industry standards and implementing them consistently.


Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with prediction markets, decentralized exchanges, or hybrid CeFi/DeFi systems.
  • Familiarity with cloud-scale infrastructure, production operations, and large-scale data storage.
  • Familiarity with trading agents using open agent platforms like OpenClaw


Why This Role

  • Directly influence the architecture and scalability of a high-performance trading platform.
  • Work hands-on with top-tier engineers on genuinely hard distributed systems problems.
  • Competitive compensation and equity for a role with real technical ownership and impact.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (JavaScript / .NET)
description:
We are looking for a full-time Senior Full Stack Developer with comprehensive knowledge of JavaScript to join the software engineering team for our US-based client.

This client saves its customers millions of dollars providing engineering services, consulting, and software for complex, global projects in the renewable energy and oil and gas industries. The clients software-as-a-service (SaaS) solutions provide key performance indicators for improved business decision making and workflows enabling inventory management, failure investigation reporting, and change management.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with product management, product owner, and key stakeholders to gain approval of proposed architecture development plan
  • Lead the development effort (may include assisting in the hiring and onboarding of additional development and QA resources to assist)
  • Assure that implemented new capabilities meet the needs of the implementation team, customers, and product management
  • Follow common development standards and development methodologies to assure efficiency and high performance
  • Participate in team the code review process
  • Work closely with backend developers to ensure the integrity of the solution
  • Mentor junior developers


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of JavaScript software development experience
  • Experience working in a .NET stack
  • Experience working with jQuery, Xamarin, and RESTful APIs
  • Familiarity with Microsoft SQL Server
  • Ability to perform unit and integration testing for comprehensive code coverage
  • Understanding of Agile methodologies
  • Excellent troubleshooting and communication skills
  • A positive attitude always looking to empower the success of others
  • Willingness to take ownership and find ways to unblock oneself
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience (optimally a technical or engineering degree)
  • Experience with Knockout or other JS frameworks
  • Experience with PWAs
  • Experience in UI/UX Design
  • Familiarity with the oil & gas industry


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately-held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Analista de Sistemas Mainframe
description:
Atribuições:

  • Levantar requisitos do negócio junto às áreas solicitantes para o entendimento e mapeamento das necessidades;
  • Executar o desenvolvimento do projeto físico, por meio da especificação e codificação de programas, segundo modelo definido em conjunto com a área de arquitetura de sistemas, em projetos ou sustentação dos sistemas;
  • Desenvolver projetos ou atendimentos de alta complexidade, compreendendo a análise da solicitação, definição de requisitos técnicos e prazo e observando os padrões estabelecidos, para aprovação do usuário.
  • Executar testes individuais e integrados de programas e sistemas, incluindo Roteiros de teste e preparação da massa de dados, para verificação de padrões de funcionamento e do atendimento à solicitação do usuário;
  • Homologar processos dos sistemas junto aos usuários, prestando apoio técnico, orientando-os na sua operacionalização e validação;
  • Acompanhar o processo de implantação, apoiando a equipe de operação, monitorando o resultado produzido, para assegurar o perfeito funcionamento;
  • Identificar possíveis pontos de problemas de infraestrutura, performance ou falhas de sistemas e propor soluções/melhorias, de modo a eliminar problemas no ambiente a curto/médio/longo prazo.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de qualidade e desempenho de sistemas, serviços e componentes, objetivando a melhoria contínua da qualidade dos serviços prestados.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Computação ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência sólida no desenvolvimento de soluções e projetos de TI;
  • Experiência nas várias fases de um projeto de Desenvolvimento de Sistemas;
  • Atuação com modelagem de Banco de Dados Relacional;
  • Conhecimento ambiente IBM, desenvolvimento em linguagem Cobol e Banco de Dados DB2;
  • Conhecimentos em processos Devops, qualidade de código, testes unitários;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de sistemas críticos.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
JDA WMS Developer

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior JDA Warehouse Management System (WMS) Solution Architect to lead end to end solution design, integration, and delivery for global transformational programs. This role requires deep functional and technical expertise in JDA WMS (Discrete), exceptional communication skills, and the ability to operate in fast paced, multi vendor environments.

You will act as the primary JDA WMS expert across strategic initiatives, driving architecture, process optimization, integration design, and overall solution governance.

Desired Skills & Experience

• Bachelor’s or higher degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, or Logistics.

• Strong hands-on experience with JDA Warehouse Management System (Discrete).

• Participation in 2–3 full end to end implementation projects.

• Strong domain knowledge of JDA WMS configuration, design, and delivery to support customer business processes.

• Extensive experience designing current and future-state architecture for enterprise clients.

• Deep expertise in:

o MOCA Components

o MTF

o DDA/Page Builder

o Reports & Labels

• Strong experience integrating JDA WMS with multiple host/destination systems using JDA Integrator/Connect.

• Hands-on experience with WCS, TMS, and Parcel integrations (any).

• Experience developing/modifying interfaces, tracing, debugging, and troubleshooting.

• Experience using support tools, project management tools, and global SharePoint.

• Knowledge of middleware integration methods (JDA Connect, MuleSoft, TIBCO).

• Solid understanding of SDLC, requirement analysis, and solution design.

• Experience working in dynamic, fast-paced, multi-vendor environments.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Strong positive attitude, ownership mindset, and focus on process improvement.

Key Responsibilities

• Actively participate in Solution Design workshops and lead end-to-end solution architecture discussions.

• Approve solution designs and validate the configured JDA WMS solution.

• Validate test concepts, test scenarios, and user acceptance criteria.

• Serve as the primary JDA WMS expert for global transformation projects and programs.

• Lead Change Management activities for global or regional implementations.

• Contribute to the Global Technology Strategy and present technical assessments to governance boards for rapid decision-making.

• Prepare and deliver presentations to users, management, and executive-level audiences.

• Advise customers on industry best practices and process methodology.

• Demonstrate and facilitate design, development, and integration discussions covering product functionality and architecture.

• Ensure smooth integration between technical and functional requirements across JDA modules.

• Proactively identify process improvement opportunities and ensure alignment with business stakeholders.

• Collaborate with Business, Service Delivery, and Service Providers in evaluating and approving new solutions.

• Drive improvements in global technology processes and service delivery.

• Translate business requirements into technical specifications and functional designs.

• Lead business process analysis, design, construction, validation, and deployment phases.

Required Qualifications

• CCNP Certification (Required)

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, or a related field.

• Advanced English


Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos
